mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with chlorpromazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonergic effects, and additive CNS depression via monoamine potentiation and anticholinergic interactions.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, use chlorpromazine at lowest effective dose with careful blood pressure monitoring and extended washout period after MAOI discontinuation.
